summary:
Session maintenance: v5.6 (map-after-breakpoint + budget-aware truncation retry) incremental Zone C caching is landed, tested, and deployed. Iter9 (n=5) completed with 4/5 success, median $0.281/20 turns and −18% cost/turn vs v5.5. Rep3 failed at 40-turn trajectory cap (temperature 1.0 luck, not cache failure); its per-turn economics match passing runs. All prior iter8 issues resolved: fresh input per turn fell from 2.4–7.6k to 36–892 tokens, billing signature converged on cached-native (cacheRead climbs monotonically, cacheWrite stays delta-sized ~1.2k), and FM-1 leaf truncations dropped from 2-of-3 runs to 0/5.

**Core completed work:**

File: `packages/core/src/assemble/format.ts` (line 81–106): Refactored `renderActiveHeader` to emit only the title line (no volatile descendant map) and new `renderActiveMap` function to emit the descendant index with seq ranges. The split prevents per-edit churn ahead of the append-only event stream. Line 81–90 documented the cache-friendly structure: Zone C head carries no volatility, events remain cache-stable, and the map (growing on edits) moves to the end.

File: `packages/core/src/assemble/assembler.ts` (line 271–291): Rewired Zone C block assembly to emit `C:head` (title only), then event blocks, then `C:map` (descendants last). Callers caching Zone C must position the breakpoint BEFORE the map so descendant churn never voids event cache. Per-turn measurement from iter8-rep1 showed the old layout re-wrote 10–16k tokens/turn while edits landed; new layout decouples map writes from event reads.

File: `packages/core/src/summarize/summarizer.ts` (line 265–295): When `stopReason === 'max_tokens'`, the reply was truncated mid-JSON and retrying at the identical budget fails byte-identically (FM-1 root cause). Now doubles `maxTokens` on retry instead. Test added and passing.

File: `eval/src/loop.ts` (lines 603–943, further revised seq 597–598): Added `toZoneCCachedRequest()` builder implementing Anthropic's cache mechanics with one `ChatMessage` per Zone C block and breakpoint placement ONLY on the last cached block (now correctly positioned before the relocated `C:map`). Prior Zone C events become 0.1× reads; map and tail ride uncached after the marker. Test validates one message per block with correct breakpoint placement (3 markers: system + Zone B end + Zone C end) and byte-identity preservation on append.

**Test updates (seq 606–612):** File `packages/core/test/assemble.test.ts` updated to expect `C:map:${active.id}` as the final Zone C block. File `eval/test/loop.test.ts` updated to reflect map-after-breakpoint: contents now show `'descendant index\n\nfetched detail'` (map+tail merged after breakpoint), and marked blocks document that only cached blocks (up to last event) carry the breakpoint. File `packages/core/test/e2e.test.ts` (seq 623–624) updated to expect the map block in the Zone C chain.

**Eval scripts created:**

File: `eval/scripts/ct-growth.mjs`: Ingests `results.json` files, computes per-turn context (input + cacheRead + cacheWrite), and reports fresh/turn (median), ctx@last, slope, quad, costUsd. Detects quadratic token growth; used to diagnose FM-7 (iter8-rep1 showed cacheRead pinned while cacheWrite grew 10–16k/turn due to map churn).

**Experiment results:**

**Iter7 (context-tree v5, tree-dsa v6, A/B test):** 3 replicates. Context-tree: rep1 failed at 40 turns ($1.01, FM-6 fresh-input signature), rep2 $0.216/10 turns (success), rep3 $0.213/
